name: List events
description: Call this when you need to retrieve a paginated list of events for a given time range, date, and filter criteria. Use the events.list_dates action instead if you need a list of the dates that contain events rather than a detailed, sortable view.

startAt.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) marking the start of the period to fetch events from.

endAt.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) marking the end of the period to fetch events up to.

date.description: The calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) for which events are queried.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return in the response.

sort.description: Sort order of the returned events by timestamp.

eventType.description: Type of events to include; "all" returns every type.

status.description: Filter events by their status; example value "sent_queued".

items.description: Array of event objects matching the query; may be null if no events are found.
